verses.1: Peter, the apostle of Jesus Christ, went out to preach among the people in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia.
verses.2: According to the foresight of God the Father, through the sanctification of the Spirit, for eternal obedience and acceptance in the blood of Jesus Christ. May grace and peace be multiplied to you.
verses.3: Praised be the Lord and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who, out of His great mercy, redeemed us for life in hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead.
verses.4: to an inheritance that is eternal, undivided, and unconditional, inherited from heaven for you.
verses.5: Those who are protected by the power of God, because of their faith, I hope will be revealed at a later time for salvation.
verses.6: Where you may find joy, if you are still grieving after experiencing various hardships.
verses.7: So that your testimony of faith may be more valuable than gold, which has been lost due to fire. This testimony can be rewarded with praise, honor, and respect when Jesus Christ reveals it.
verses.8: Those whom you do not see, you love; those whom you do not even recognize, you believe in and respect them with joy and admiration.
verses.9: We seek to achieve the end of your faith – the salvation of souls.
verses.10: For whom they sought salvation and revealed it through prophets who prophesied about the grace given to you.
verses.11: By observing how long it takes for the spirit of Christ to manifest itself in them, we can understand the sufferings that Christ endured, as well as the glory that follows after those sufferings.
verses.12: It became clear that these things were not done by them alone. Instead, they were conveyed to you through the holy spirit sent from heaven by those who have been sent to preach the good news to you. This is what the prophets desire.
verses.13: Therefore, seeking to revive the teachings of your faith, they hoped fully that Jesus Christ would be revealed to you.
verses.14: As children who remain obedient, without becoming shaped by your previously unconscious desires.
verses.15: But according to the calling that has brought you here, you are holy. And they too are holy in every change that happens.
verses.16: For it is written that you became holy, that I am holy.
verses.17: And even if you were called upon by your father to judge each person according to their actions, in fear of losing your possessions, you would still be willing to change your ways.
verses.18: You know that you have been freed from the bondage of darkness, from gold and silver, through your transformation from being slaves to being free.
verses.19: But with honorable blood, as I remember, as a witness to Christ’s sacrifice.
verses.20: Before the world was created, it was revealed to you. But after the end of time, it became visible through you.
verses.21: He raised those who were faithful to God from the dead through him, and gave him glory, so that your faith and hope could be in God.
verses.22: In your perseverance in the truth, you loved each other deeply, without any selfish motives, from the depths of your hearts.
verses.23: They were not renewed from decaying flesh, but from being made new. This happened because of the words of God, who continued to live and remain steadfast.
verses.24: For every plant is like a flower, and every glory of it is like a flower’s beauty. But when the flower withers, so too does its beauty.
verses.25: But the message of the Lord remains valid throughout time. This is the message of those who have been sent to evangelize you.
